title: Active queries and idle-in-transaction sessions longer than minDuration
description: Sessions from pg_stat_activity, longest first. The task's own backend and walsenders are not listed.

visibility.description: partial: the role is neither a superuser nor a member of pg_read_all_stats, so other roles' sessions cannot be read and items lists only the role's own. The run reports permission_denied scoped to pg_stat_activity.

hiddenSessions.description: Client sessions of other roles whose details the role cannot read (0 when visibility is full)

queryTextIncluded.description: The includeQueryText setting; when false no entry has query

kind.description: active: a query running now. idleInTransaction: a transaction open and waiting for the client (aborted included)

durationMs.description: kind active: ms since the query started (now - query_start). kind idleInTransaction: ms since the session went idle (now - state_change)

xactAgeMs.description: ms since the transaction started (now - xact_start); null when the session has no xact_start (an aborted transaction, for example)

queryId.description: The query_id as text; null unless compute_query_id computes it (on, or auto with a module that uses it) and the server is PostgreSQL 14 or later

blockedBy.description: pg_blocking_pids: the pids this session waits for; empty when it is not blocked

query.description: Only with includeQueryText: the statement with literals replaced by ?, comments dropped and whitespace collapsed, cut to 1024 bytes

queryTruncated.description: Only with includeQueryText: query was cut to 1024 bytes

total.description: Sessions longer than minDuration (a lower bound when visibility is partial)

omitted.description: Sessions left out of items by maxItems

truncated.description: true when items was cut at maxItems
